verdict_explanation: No mechanical rules errors or essential in-scope omissions found. All thirty printed activation/Place entries agree. One nonessential header claim lacks support in the permitted sources.

scope.base: 2014 dlp English printed pp.12–21; all twenty base Places pp.22–23; components p.24
scope.clarification: Only the 2015 publisher explicit Town Hall same/separate-actions analogy on p.3 and publisher/year credit p.24
excluded: Questions, answer keys, reader outputs/grades, material-fact checklists, earlier audits, coverage reviews, adjudications and README
scope.independence: Fresh audit; no summary edits or reader communication.

findings.issue: The supplied 2014 base source does not state a playing duration. The ninety-minute metadata therefore cannot be independently substantiated from the permitted authoritative sources. This is a provenance gap, not an identified gameplay error.
findings.recommended_action: Provide an authoritative duration source or omit this unsourced metadata from a claim of complete source verification.

checked_claims.claim: Scope, player count, designer and component quantities
checked_claims.detail: 2–4-player setup and all listed component counts agree. Reiner Stockhausen credited on p.24. Original 2014 base Place scope is respected.

Four marked Followers begin on Market; five coins, ten stations, seven markers; Merchant in Orléans; six Character markers and Development marker at first spaces; thirteen placed Citizens plus one set aside.
Lighter Pilgrimage begins the shuffled eighteen-tile stack; face-down randomized goods then face-up map placement; remaining goods in market; I/II Place stacks.
All profession removals, random goods reductions and numbered empty goods spaces agree.
Eighteen seven-phase rounds; youngest Start Player; unique Farmers-track leaders/last and two-player exception; leftward Start Player transfer.
At most Knight allowance and free Market capacity; retained Market tiles; bag inspection then mixing; one Action-to-Market recovery per declined draw, no Action-to-Action movement.

Simultaneous planning with clockwise fallback; partial placement across rounds; full activation except Town Hall; one action per clockwise turn; passing final; unused activations retained; normal used Followers return to bag.
